Processed RNA-seq expression matrix (GEO GSE52778)

Source: R/data.R
airway_heatmap.Rd

A small, ready-to-plot expression matrix taken from a real RNA-seq experiment, so that examples and vignettes can start from processed data instead of re-running the preprocessing on every render.

Usage

airway_heatmap

Format

A list with six components:

z

numeric matrix, 300 genes x 8 samples: row z-scores, rows in cluster order; rows are named by gene symbol, columns by <cell line>_<treatment>.

genes

data frame with gene, gene_set ("up in dexamethasone" or "down in dexamethasone") and delta (mean z-score in treated minus untreated samples).

samples

data frame with sample, cell and dex columns.

df

long data frame ready for ggplot2: gene, sample, gene_set and z. gene is a factor whose levels run in reverse cluster order, so geom_tile() draws the first cluster row at the top.

mark

character vector of 20 gene names used by the single-panel example (12 genes from the top response cluster plus 8 scattered genes).

mark_by_set

named list with the four strongest responders of each gene set, used by the faceted example.

Source

doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0099625 (airway RNA-seq, GEO GSE52778).

Details

The experiment profiled human airway smooth muscle cells: four cell lines, each treated with dexamethasone or left untreated (8 samples in total). The original read counts come from the airway Bioconductor package (GEO series GSE52778, Himes et al. 2014, PLoS ONE 9(6): e99625). The object bundled here was prepared once with the following steps:

  1. keep genes expressed in at least four samples (CPM > 1);

  2. log2(CPM + 1) transform;

  3. drop duplicated gene symbols so every label is unique;

  4. keep the 300 most variable genes and z-score each gene across samples;

  5. order the genes by hierarchical clustering (hclust(dist(z), method = "ward.D2")).

Examples

str(airway_heatmap, max.level = 1)
#> List of 6
#>  $ z          : num [1:300, 1:8] 0.161 0.572 0.544 0.814 0.567 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>  $ genes      :'data.frame':	300 obs. of  3 variables:
#>  $ samples    :'data.frame':	8 obs. of  3 variables:
#>  $ df         :'data.frame':	2400 obs. of  4 variables:
#>  $ mark       : chr [1:20] "EBF3" "PCDHGA12" "RUNX3" "DCLK1" ...
#>  $ mark_by_set:List of 2
dim(airway_heatmap$z)
#> [1] 300   8
head(airway_heatmap$df)
#>       gene       sample              gene_set         z
#> 1     EBF3 N61311_untrt down in dexamethasone 0.1610692
#> 2 PCDHGA12 N61311_untrt down in dexamethasone 0.5721993
#> 3    RUNX3 N61311_untrt   up in dexamethasone 0.5444419
#> 4    DCLK1 N61311_untrt down in dexamethasone 0.8143485
#> 5     RHOU N61311_untrt down in dexamethasone 0.5673247
#> 6  ALDH1A1 N61311_untrt down in dexamethasone 0.2585896
